title: Even majority total influence error
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a Boolean function on the cube of dimension $2m+2$. Its even majority total influence error is $\operatorname{Inf}(f)-\sqrt{2/\pi}\,\sqrt{2m+2}$, where $\operatorname{Inf}(f)$ denotes the total influence of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the cube of dimension $2m+2$
